requirements.name: Voltage meaning and stress
requirements.requirement: Resolve 650 V meaning; maximum DC link including regeneration and tolerances, switching overshoot, uncertainty, device-specific surge/lifetime envelope and approved margin policy
requirements.verification: Reviewed voltage budget and measured drain waveforms

requirements.name: Topology and load
requirements.requirement: Specify inverter/DC-DC/other topology, number of phases, motor/load, RMS/peak current, power, duty cycle and regeneration

requirements.name: Loss and frequency budget
requirements.requirement: Select frequency/dead time from matched conduction, switching, reverse-conduction and driver losses over temperature and load
requirements.verification: Condition-matched loss curves, vendor models and double-pulse validation

requirements.name: Thermal envelope
requirements.requirement: Bound junction/case/ambient temperature, transient impedance, interface and heat-sink performance, power cycling and cooling failure
requirements.verification: Coupled loss/thermal model and instrumented thermal validation

requirements.name: Gate drive
requirements.requirement: Use part-specific gate or integrated-driver supply limits, startup/shutdown sequencing, isolation, CMTI and Kelvin return/layout where applicable
requirements.verification: Reviewed gate-drive schematic and switching waveforms

requirements.name: Fault handling
requirements.requirement: Coordinate current sensing, short-circuit detection, fault turn-off overshoot, interlock, dead time and restart; do not assume avalanche/short-circuit ratings transfer across families
requirements.verification: Fault tests and protection timing/energy budget

requirements.name: Isolation and enclosure
requirements.requirement: Determine applicable insulation requirements, working/transient voltages, clearance/creepage, pollution/altitude, enclosure and discharge requirements
requirements.verification: Application-specific insulation review; no universal spacing number supplied

requirements.name: EMI and motor interface
requirements.requirement: Evaluate parasitics, dv/dt, common-mode current, cable/motor insulation, sensing interference and bearing effects as applicable
requirements.verification: Layout/parasitic review and EMC/motor compatibility tests

requirements.name: Packaging and assembly
requirements.requirement: Resolve discrete versus module, thermal path, mounting insulation/torque, footprint, assembly process and serviceability
requirements.verification: Verified package model and assembly/thermal-interface drawing

requirements.name: Procurement and cost
requirements.requirement: Obtain current lifecycle/stock/lead-time and equivalent quantity/currency quotes; include switches, drivers, cooling, magnetics, filtering and validation cost
requirements.verification: Dated supplier quotes and complete subsystem cost model

requirements.name: Scientific evidence
requirements.requirement: If material/defect claims are required, retain structure/polytype, periodic method, convergence, energy reference, band/k-point/spin and field semantics
requirements.verification: Reviewed periodic-calculation or measurement manifest; optional for COTS selection

requirements.name: Release and traceability
requirements.requirement: Link evidence to requirements and actual parts; preserve missing values; validate target IR schema and application import; keep release blocked until qualification
requirements.verification: Reviewed qualification record and target-project import receipt
